baseline.base_desc_result: The input //base:base matches no targets, configs or files.

first_m1_1_slice.source_selection_policy: Expose a narrowly gated Base source set only when enable_chromium_wasm_port and is_wasm are both true; do not classify Wasm as POSIX or Linux.

blocker_groups.root_cause: The M0 graph intentionally exposes only the standalone hello target, while Base explicitly rejects Wasm and has no Wasm platform source block.

entries.platform_assumption: The primary Wasm graph ends at //wasm:hello_wasm.
entries.wasm_plan: Add each passing M1 smoke label to the opt-in Wasm root group without loading V8, Content, Ozone, or Chrome.

entries.platform_assumption: Most Wasm toolchains must not build Chromium Base.
entries.wasm_plan: Narrow the assertion to permit the explicit Chromium port and add //base:base_wasm_primitives before attempting the full //base target.

entries.platform_assumption: Platform implementations are selected only for POSIX, Linux, Apple, Android, Fuchsia, or Windows.
entries.wasm_plan: Add one explicit Wasm source list, reusing only Emscripten-backed pthread and virtual-filesystem implementations whose semantics are verified.

blocker_groups.root_cause: Core Base headers define native types only for existing desktop/mobile families even though IS_WASM is intentionally separate from IS_POSIX.

entries.platform_assumption: Thread IDs and handles are Windows, Fuchsia, Apple, or POSIX types.
entries.wasm_plan: Define a Wasm thread ID and pthread-backed handle explicitly, then implement creation, join, yield, sleep, and diagnostic naming in platform_thread_wasm.cc.

entries.platform_assumption: pthread_mutex_t and pthread_cond_t are exposed only for POSIX or Fuchsia.
entries.wasm_plan: Expose pthread types for Wasm in these ABI headers and deliberately select the generic pthread implementations.

entries.platform_assumption: Integer virtual file descriptors are declared only for POSIX or Fuchsia.
entries.wasm_plan: Declare Emscripten VFS descriptors as a Wasm platform-file type without setting IS_POSIX.

entries.platform_assumption: Narrow string paths and stat metadata are available only to POSIX/Fuchsia.
entries.wasm_plan: Add targeted Wasm branches using Emscripten's narrow paths and stat ABI; do not claim persistence.

entries.platform_assumption: A process handle is an OS HANDLE, zx handle, or pid_t.
entries.wasm_plan: Use a stable process-local integer identity and keep launch/enumeration explicitly unsupported.

blocker_groups.root_cause: The pinned Base implementation has no Wasm-specific providers for time, entropy, threads, paths, files, process data, or system data.

entries.platform_assumption: The current provider is selected from native platform clocks.
entries.wasm_plan: Implement TimeNowIgnoringOverride with Emscripten's wall-clock source in base/time/time_wasm.cc.

entries.platform_assumption: The current provider assumes native clock_gettime constants.
entries.wasm_plan: Implement TimeTicks with the pinned runtime monotonic clock, report high resolution accurately, and keep wall time out of elapsed calculations.

entries.platform_assumption: CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID is available.
entries.wasm_plan: Report ThreadTicks support only if the pinned runtime supplies it; otherwise return the API's explicit unsupported state.

entries.current_source: base/time/time.h:1178-1187; platform-specific TimeTicks::GetClock and IsHighResolution implementations
entries.platform_assumption: Each native clock provider declares its actual resolution and clock identity.
entries.wasm_plan: Add an Emscripten monotonic clock identity, report its real resolution, and verify bounded sleeps and delayed deadlines without borrowing the Linux clock label.

entries.platform_assumption: POSIX reads secure bytes from a native entropy source.
entries.wasm_plan: Use Emscripten getentropy, backed by Web Crypto or Node crypto, and fail explicitly if unavailable.

entries.platform_assumption: The public header unconditionally includes the BoringSSL system-entropy API, but the M1 checkout has not hydrated the BoringSSL gitlink.
entries.wasm_plan: Keep the API and use the nonallocating Wasm RandBytes provider behind a targeted build flag instead of requiring BoringSSL for the focused Base gate.

entries.platform_assumption: The generic POSIX implementation also manages native scheduling priority and niceness.
entries.wasm_plan: Add platform_thread_wasm.cc around Emscripten pthread creation/join/yield/sleep and explicit best-effort names; do not reuse native priority code.

entries.platform_assumption: Native thread IDs and enforced OS thread names are available.
entries.wasm_plan: Return stable per-pthread IDs and make names explicitly best-effort diagnostics when the host cannot enforce them.

entries.platform_assumption: pthread keys and destructors are available.
entries.wasm_plan: Select the generic pthread TLS implementation explicitly for Wasm and verify isolation and destruction across workers.

entries.platform_assumption: pthread mutex and condition-variable semantics are available.
entries.wasm_plan: Select the pthread implementations explicitly, with priority inheritance disabled and timeout behavior tested on workers.

entries.platform_assumption: Lock and ConditionVariable provide the wait/wake substrate.
entries.wasm_plan: Select the generic implementation explicitly and verify manual reset, auto reset, timeout, and cross-worker wake.

entries.platform_assumption: The POSIX provider consults native executable, home, XDG, and temporary directories.
entries.wasm_plan: Add base_paths_wasm.cc with explicit Emscripten VFS current, temporary, module, and profile-placeholder paths.

entries.platform_assumption: POSIX open/read/write/seek/truncate/fsync/rename/stat calls address a native filesystem.
entries.wasm_plan: Reuse only calls whose semantics are supplied by the Emscripten in-memory VFS, selected behind Wasm-specific source files or a documented source list.

entries.platform_assumption: Directory iteration and stat use the POSIX ABI.
entries.wasm_plan: Deliberately select the implementation after verifying nested directories, metadata, missing paths, and close semantics in MEMFS.

entries.platform_assumption: Process identity and handles are kernel PIDs.
entries.wasm_plan: Add process_handle_wasm.cc with one stable local identity; no fake child or OS handle.

entries.platform_assumption: The platform can spawn an operating-system process.
entries.wasm_plan: Do not source-select launch code; expose a clear unsupported result at the feature boundary.

entries.platform_assumption: Page size, CPU count, memory, and OS data come from native syscalls and procfs.
entries.wasm_plan: Add sys_info_wasm.cc and report only runtime values that can be measured accurately.

blocker_groups.root_cause: The generic task pump is present but unreachable until Base primitives compile and has not been behaviorally validated on an application pthread.

entries.platform_assumption: MessagePumpDefault sleeps and wakes through WaitableEvent.
entries.wasm_plan: Retain MessagePumpDefault first; verify nested loops, delayed work, cross-thread wake, quit, idle wait count, and browser heartbeat before considering a Wasm-specific pump.

entries.platform_assumption: MessagePump::Create(DEFAULT) returns a usable pump for the current thread.
entries.wasm_plan: Run the executor on the PROXY_TO_PTHREAD application thread and machine-check immediate, delayed, nested, bidirectional, and clean-shutdown behavior.

blocker_groups.root_cause: M0 records the Chromium Rust archive but does not install it, and the pinned package has no wasm32-unknown-emscripten standard library.

entries.platform_assumption: The Rust archive pin exists in DEPS, but M0 needs no installed compiler.
entries.wasm_plan: Extend bootstrap with an exact archive download, SHA-256 verification, extraction, installed-version verification, and offline verify-only path.

entries.platform_assumption: The packaged sysroot contains only the supported native target stdlib.
entries.wasm_plan: Build a local wasm32-unknown-emscripten stdlib from the pinned rustc-src with panic=abort and reproducibly verify its provenance.

entries.platform_assumption: C and C++ receive -pthread, but Rust has no matching Wasm target features.
entries.wasm_plan: Compile Rust and its stdlib with matching atomics, bulk-memory, mutable-globals, and pthread-compatible link settings.

blocker_groups.root_cause: Chromium GN explicitly disables Rust for Wasm and lacks the target triple, architecture, and known-target entries.

entries.platform_assumption: The Chromium Rust toolchain supports every platform except Wasm.
entries.wasm_plan: Enable toolchain_has_rust only after bootstrap verifies the Wasm stdlib.

entries.platform_assumption: No mapping exists for current_os=emscripten and current_cpu=wasm.
entries.wasm_plan: Map to wasm32-unknown-emscripten and add the exact triple to the allowlist.

entries.platform_assumption: rust_target_arch has no current_cpu=wasm branch.
entries.wasm_plan: Set rust_target_arch to wasm32 for local stdlib construction.

entries.platform_assumption: rustc emits rlibs or static archives and the C++ linker owns the final executable.
entries.wasm_plan: Reuse the Chromium wrapper, emit no cross-revision LLVM bitcode, and consume Rust output through the Emscripten em++ final link.

entries.platform_assumption: Target stdlib and consumers must agree on panic strategy.
entries.wasm_plan: Use panic=abort and add a separate expected-failure runner that rejects false success.

entries.platform_assumption: Non-Chromium builds use Rust System allocation.
entries.wasm_plan: Validate Vec, String, heap allocation, and frees against Emscripten's allocator before any PartitionAlloc integration.

entries.platform_assumption: The generated M0 configuration disables the Chromium Rust prelude with the rest of Rust.
entries.wasm_plan: Enable and compile the pinned prelude only after the target stdlib works, then include its import test in the Wasm Rust graph.

entries.platform_assumption: Chromium CXX generates the supported bridge between C++ and Rust.
entries.wasm_plan: Model the smoke on the existing CXX target and prove both call directions in one Wasm module.

entries.platform_assumption: The target stdlib and final module are compiled with Emscripten pthread support.
entries.wasm_plan: Spawn and join a Rust worker, verify atomic handoff, and require the browser heartbeat to continue during the join.

entries.platform_assumption: Rust test executables use a native runner.
entries.wasm_plan: Use dedicated Node/browser M1 smoke runners first; enable generic Rust unit tests only after the Wasm executable path is supported.

blocker_groups.root_cause: Base shared memory assumes kernel-backed platform handles, while Wasm needs process-local capabilities with explicit rights and lifetimes.

entries.platform_assumption: The final fallback is a POSIX FDPair even though its declaration is unavailable on Wasm.
entries.wasm_plan: Add an opaque region ID, generation, and rights capability type; never use a raw pointer or fake file descriptor.

entries.platform_assumption: A kernel object owns storage and duplicates native handles.
entries.wasm_plan: Implement an aligned process-local registry with unique generation-checked capabilities, GUID and mode validation, duplicate/close references, and stale-handle rejection.

entries.platform_assumption: Native mappings retain storage independently of the originating handle.
entries.wasm_plan: Track active mappings separately so storage survives handle close until the final unmap.

entries.platform_assumption: The OS can enforce page permissions for mappings.
entries.wasm_plan: Enforce read-only capability transitions at Base and Mojo API boundaries and document that raw Wasm linear-memory pointers lack hardware page protection.

blocker_groups.root_cause: Pinned Mojo uses ipcz, but its platform wrappers and shared-buffer serialization fall through to native handles even though local ipcz portals do not require serialization.

entries.platform_assumption: Legacy Mojo core is ChromeOS-only; all other platforms use ipcz.
entries.wasm_plan: Port the ipcz path and initialize exactly one in-process node; do not enable legacy core.

entries.platform_assumption: Every supported platform has an fd, native HANDLE, zx handle, or Mach port.
entries.wasm_plan: Represent only the process-local shared-region capability needed by ipcz; native handle wrap/unwrap returns MOJO_RESULT_UNIMPLEMENTED.

entries.platform_assumption: A process channel can be built from a native endpoint.
entries.wasm_plan: Add explicit invalid or unsupported Wasm behavior; do not create socketpairs, pipes, or fake endpoints.

entries.platform_assumption: The generic fallback serializes one or two POSIX file descriptors.
entries.wasm_plan: Add explicit Wasm capability branches and reject remote serialization; keep validation and ownership checks intact.

entries.platform_assumption: Two local portals may move attached API objects directly without a transport.
entries.wasm_plan: Use one local pipe and attach a boxed shared buffer through the C system API without invitation, platform channel, transport, or second node.

entries.platform_assumption: Core thunks own message, handle, mapping, and close lifetimes.
entries.wasm_plan: Create, map, write, attach, send, receive, extract, map, verify, and close a shared buffer through one in-process Mojo message pipe.
